failureReason: The model successfully wrote code to implement Partial Pre-rendering (PPR) with Suspense boundaries, but the implementation is incorrect. It created a single Suspense boundary wrapping one DashboardData component that makes a single getDashboardData() call, which gates all three sections (CardStats, RevenueChart, LatestInvoices) together. The test requires each section to suspend independently, not collapse into a single all-or-nothing loading state.
